label: PayPal Account Suspension Phishing Email
description: Spoofed headers, urgent 24h deadline, credential harvesting link.
input:
From: service@paypal-security-update.xyz
Reply-To: support@fraud-response-ticket.top
Subject: Urgent: Your PayPal account has been suspended!

Dear customer,

We detected unauthorized access attempts on your account from an unknown IP address. Immediate action required: your account will be permanently blocked within 24 hours unless you verify your identity.

Click here to confirm your credentials and update billing details: http://paypal.com.account-verification-service.xyz/login

Do not reply to this email.
